messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired 3D tower defense game featuring varied heroes, levels, attacks, abilities, skins, enemies, bosses, maps, deck building, and story.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game with custom canvas-rendered battlefield art and responsive HTML/CSS UI.
- Game setting and campaign are “Starfall Tactics,” starting at Moonlit Crossing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with mission UI, battlefield canvas, hero deck, encounter intel, objectives, and modal container.
- Created `styles.css` with desktop/mobile layouts, HUD, deck cards, and modal styling.
- Began `game.js` with hero data, map route/terrain rendering, towers, enemies, and game logic/UI functions.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`; current file is incomplete and does not yet include game update loop, input handlers, or deck/map/help modal implementations.
- Run the game and verify behavior and appearance; fix errors and capture a latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js`: implement update loop, wave completion/loss, pointer/keyboard/button handlers, audio, deck/map/help dialogs, and initialization.
2. Check for JavaScript syntax/runtime errors and test the playable loop.
3. Capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; adjust presentation as needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and modal shell.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `game.js`: In-progress battlefield rendering and game logic; continue here.

## Important Context
- The latest `game.js` write ended after `castAbility()`; functions below this point are missing, although HTML references handlers for launch, ability, speed, sound, help, deck, map, and modals.
- No screenshot or playtest has been performed yet.
